item.description: Good afternoon, Naresh! It's Friday, May 29th, 2026, here in Sydney, and as we ease into the afternoon, we're sitting at a pleasant 18°C under partly cloudy skies, though it feels a touch cooler at 17°C with an 18 km/h breeze. As you wrap things up and head home, keep that umbrella handy as there's a 100% chance of rain for your commute, so let's make sure we're driving safely and staying dry tonight. Remember, as author Kurt Vonnegut once said, "Enjoy the little things, for one day you may look back and realize they were the big things." So, enjoy those small moments of winding down, have a wonderful and safe evening, get some good rest, and we'll catch you back here tomorrow for another Daily Drive.
